proposal.risk_audit: All 3 features are dimensionless by construction (numerator and denominator scale as L2/T3 for flux/neq and L/T for shear). Denominators include omega*Umag*Umag>0 off-wall or sqrt(k+Umag^2)>0, so finite on >99% (only 0 where Umag=k=0). Bounded forms avoid inf; ordering distinguishes APG/FPG, Pk vs eps imbalance, and wall-shear vs free-shear. No duplication of q_pgrad/q_conv/q_wall: adds turbulent/inertial scaling and wall-distance shear.

features.name: f_shear_wall

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 dimensionless (Umag~sqrt(k)~L/T; UgradP~sqrt(k)*DUDt~eps~Pk~UgradK~L2/T3 so ratios invariant under V*2 L*3). Denominators >0 via k,eps; finite except stagnation where k>0 holds. features.name: f_pg_shear
features.rationale: Pressure-gradient magnitude vs shear and turbulent acceleration scale; marks APG separation onset where pressure force overwhelms shear.

features.name: f_rot_adv
features.rationale: Rotation-advection vs total mean acceleration; isolates curvature-dominated turning from straight acceleration in bumps and C-D channel.

features.name: f_kdiff_prod
features.rationale: Turbulent k-diffusion flux vs production/dissipation; marks bubble edge and reattachment where transport dominates non-equilibrium.

features: x / (1 + x), x = sqrt(k) / (0.09 omega d)

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 proposed ratios are dimensionless (L2/T2 over L2/T2, L2/T3 over L2/T3, and (1/T over 1/T)*(L2/T3 over L2/T3)) so invariant under V->2V, L->3L. Denominators contain eps>0 or omega>0 (eps/(Snorm+Wnorm+omega)>0, |.|+eps>0, Snorm+Wnorm+omega>0) so strictly positive and finite everywhere; numerators finite, so finite on ~100% points and non-constant. They target the worst heldout converging_diverging_channel (0.4712) via APG-vs-stress thickness, mean-power non-equilibrium, and curvature-signed-by-APG to separate diverging separation from converging acceleration. Dropped 3 unused zero-gain features to free slots; kept q_wall/q_aniso/q_lim/f_accel_shear that drive best formula.

features.name: f_neq_bal

features.name: f_strain_rot

features.name: f_apg_acc

features.name: f_prod_eff
features.rationale: Shear-normalized production efficiency (signed) marks non-equilibrium shear layers where Boussinesq alignment fails in separation and reattachment.

features.name: f_force_bal
features.rationale: Inertia minus pressure-force balance marks pressure-dominated APG separation (-) vs inertia-dominated throat acceleration (+) in CD channel and bumps.

features.name: f_stress_pow
features.rationale: Modeled anisotropic stress power vs production/dissipation detects misalignment where linear SST stress magnitude cannot explain Pk, needing nonlinear T2/T3.

features: x / (1 + x), x = sqrt(k) / (0.09 omega d)

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 are dimensionless under V->2V, L->3L (UgradK,Pk,eps ~ L2/T3; gradp,Umag*Snorm,eps/(sqrtk+Umag) ~ L/T2; DUDt*sqrtk ~ L2/T3). Denominators contain eps>0 so finite even at wall (Umag=k=0); bounded monotonic orderings distinct from active set; drop list only gain<=0 (f_shear_lift negative, f_pg_stress/f_acc_power zero and superseded).

features.name: f_adv_prod
features.rationale: Signed k-advection vs production/dissipation; marks non-equilibrium transport upstream vs downstream of separation bubble and reattachment.

features.name: f_pgrad_shear
features.rationale: Pressure force vs mean-shear inertia plus turbulent scale; locates APG-dominated separation where pressure overwhelms shear vs FPG throat.

features.name: f_acc_tke

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 formulas checked dimensionless under V->2V L->3L (velocity-scale numerators/denominators). Denominators >0 at cell centers (d*omega>0, k>0 interior, Snorm*k+eps>0); wall 0/0 points <1% so finite>=99%. Bounded [0,1] or [-1,1] so no overflow; ordering only matters due to median rescaling. Overlap with f_accel_shear/q_lim/f_ti_sep kept low: wall-frequency vs TI, APG*d vs APG/Pk, shear-scale vs production-efficiency. Drops are all heldout_gain=0 and redundant with replacements.

features.name: f_wall_freq
features.rationale: Turbulent frequency wall scale vs mean advection; separates near-wall APG/separation (near 1) from free-shear/FPG throat in CD channel and bumps.

features.name: f_apg_wall
features.rationale: Signed APG work weighted by wall distance vs k-advection; positive marks APG separation bubble, negative marks FPG acceleration in CD channel.

features.name: f_shear_param
features.rationale: Mean-shear energy scale vs actual production/dissipation; detects misalignment where linear SST stress cannot explain Pk needing nonlinear T2/T3.

proposal.risk_audit: All formulas dimensionally checked ([L/T2] for inertia/pressure, [L2/T2] for energy, [L2/T] for viscosity) so invariant to velocity/length rescaling; denominators include strictly-positive turbulent scales eps/(S+W+omega) and sqrt(eps*(S+W+omega)) since omega>0, eps>0, so finite everywhere including wall and freestream; bounded [0,1] so median-normalization preserves ordering; new features orthogonal to I1/I2 (which already encode Snorm,Wnorm/omega) by adding d, gradp, DUDt, nut; drops are zero-gain/zero-use redundant features to avoid collinearity and overfitting.

features.name: f_pg_wall
features.rationale: Wall-weighted pressure force vs kinetic energy; high in APG separation bubble, low in FPG throat and free shear.

features.name: f_inert_pg
features.rationale: Mean inertia vs pressure force; separates acceleration/curvature reattachment from pressure-dominated separation.

features.name: f_wall_turb
features.rationale: Turbulent wall Reynolds; distinguishes viscous near-wall APG/separation from outer free-shear anisotropy error.

features: UgradP / (abs(UgradP) + gradp_mag*(Umag + sqrt(k) + omega*d) + Snorm*k + eps)

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 proposed are dimensionless (1/T vs 1/T; L2/T3 vs L2/T3; L2/T vs L2/T), denominators strictly positive off-wall (omega>0, eps+gradp*V>0, omega*d^2>0 at cell centers) so finite on >99%; bounded forms avoid blow-up; ordering distinct from active q_lim/f_ti_sep/f_accel_shear; drops are gain 0.0 and superseded (signed APG and wall-frequency).

features.name: f_rot_shear
features.rationale: Rotation vs strain (curvature) marker: >0 rotation-dominated bubble core needing T2/T3, <0 strain-dominated FPG throat/attached layer.

features.name: f_apg_align
features.formula: UgradP / (abs(UgradP) + gradp_mag*(Umag + sqrt(k) + omega*d) + Snorm*k + eps)
features.rationale: Signed APG work vs pressure-plus-shear power; + APG separation vs - FPG acceleration to fix CD-channel worst error.

features.name: f_wall_rey
features.rationale: Wall-distance turbulent Reynolds (0 near wall, ~1 free shear) to separate near-wall APG/separation from free-shear reattachment.

proposal.risk_audit: All three are dimensionless by V/L scaling (checked units), denominators contain k or eps floors so finite except pathological zero-turbulence points, bounded 0-1 or -1-1 to avoid outliers; they replace overlapping complex APG/wall/TI markers with orthogonal orderings (direction vs magnitude, rotation vs strain, pressure vs modeled stress) to reduce redundancy with I1/I2 and limit overfit to CD-channel APG separation.

features.name: f_apg_cos
features.rationale: Pure APG/FPG alignment cos(U,gradp): +1 adverse separation vs -1 favorable acceleration, isolates direction to fix CD-channel worst error.

features.name: f_accel_rot
features.rationale: Mean acceleration vs rotation-advection plus turbulent scale; complements Snorm-only marker to flag curved reattachment vs vortex-core non-equilibrium.

features.name: f_pg_stress
features.rationale: Wall-weighted pressure force vs modeled anisotropic stress plus k; high where pressure overwhelms SST stress in APG bubble, low in attached/FPG.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 are dimensionless (L2/T3 vs L2/T3 for pressure/work features; L/T vs L/T for velocity-deficit) and bounded in [0,1] or [-1,1] so median-normalization preserves ordering. Denominators contain eps or sqrt(eps/(Snorm+Wnorm+omega))>0 so finite even at wall/stagnation; no log/exp blow-up. Collinearity: f_pg_turb uses turbulent velocity scale vs f_pgrad_shear mean-inertia scale (dropped); f_apg_bal uses pressure-work vs cascade vs f_adv_prod k-advection (dropped); f_vel_def adds wall-distance shear deficit distinct from I1/I2 and q_lim. Retained q_aniso/q_lim (positive gain) and marginal negatives f_wall_rey/f_accel_rot to preserve current best; dropped 3 zero-use features to free search and limit overfit. Targets worst heldout converging_diverging_channel APG separation vs FPG throat.

features.name: f_apg_bal
features.rationale: Signed APG power vs turbulence cascade; +1 separation energy sink vs -1 FPG acceleration to fix CD-channel bubble/throat.

features.name: f_vel_def
features.rationale: Wall-distance shear vs local advection velocity; high in low-speed bubble/near-wall APG, low in high-speed FPG throat.

features.name: f_pg_turb
features.rationale: Pressure force at turbulent velocity scale vs dissipation/production; marks where APG overwhelms SST stress in bubble edge.
